title: Mount Zion
lead: Zion was the hill of David's fortress, then the temple mount, then a name for Jerusalem and for God's people. Genesis 22's "mountain of the LORD" and Exodus 15:17's "mountain of your inheritance" were read as pointing to it; the psalms and prophets sing of it (Psalm 48; Isaiah 2:2–4); Hebrews and Revelation speak of a heavenly Mount Zion (Hebrews 12:22; Revelation 14:1).
